description: Priority scoring for all below-median capabilities using 6-factor formula. Determines which gaps should be addressed first in transformation roadmap.

BI_Business_Impact.rationale: [Why this gap impacts [Institution]: direct revenue impact, member experience, etc.]

RE_Risk_Exposure.rationale: [Regulatory risk if not addressed; enforcement history context]

CG_Competitive_Gap.rationale: [Gap vs. peer median; distance from laggard threshold]

EI_Effort_Inverse.rationale: [Estimated effort: quick wins (strategy, culture) vs. long implementation (data, tech)]

TM_Trend_Momentum.rationale: [Is capability declining? Improving? Stagnant for years?]

prioritized_gaps.root_cause_analysis: [Why is [Institution] scoring below peers on this capability? What's the underlying constraint?]
prioritized_gaps.institutional_context: [How does [Institution]'s specific situation (size, geography, business model) affect this gap?]
prioritized_gaps.transformation_opportunity: [If addressed, what capability could improve to? What would be the strategic impact?]
prioritized_gaps.linked_capabilities: [Other capabilities that depend on fixing this gap, or that could be fixed together]

capability_trend_analysis.capabilities_improving: [List of capabilities showing positive trend if reassessment]

quick_wins_identification.description: Gaps that could be addressed in <6 months with high strategic impact

cross_capability_dependencies.description: Capabilities that should be addressed together or in sequence

dependency_groups.dependency_logic: [Why these should be addressed together; e.g., 'P4C1 Data Mgmt is prerequisite for P4C2 Analytics and P2C4 Personalization']

assessment_vs_peer_positioning.quartile_positioning: [If in P25 (bottom quartile) vs. P75 (top quartile) for each capability]

strategic_implications.overall_assessment: [Summary: Is [Institution] strategically aligned with digital maturity? Lagging? Leading?]
strategic_implications.strengths: [What is [Institution] doing well relative to peers?]
strategic_implications.constraints_on_advancement: [What are the primary barriers preventing higher maturity scores? Root causes?]
strategic_implications.transformation_thesis: [If [Institution] addresses top 3 priorities in the recommended sequence, what overall score improvement could be achieved? Timeline?]

priority_tier_distribution.check: Do tier counts sum to total below-median count?
